pages.text: Banded gold and shadow. Found in exactly one world — and it isn't this one.

pages.title: A Stone From Elsewhere
pages.text: Tiger's Eye forms in one place only: the $(l:orespawn_integrations:dimensions/crystal_dimension)Crystal Dimension$(), banded into crystal stone beside veins of pink tourmaline.$(p)Getting there costs everything — literally. The termite couriers carry only travelers with empty pockets. Plan the expedition, cache your gear at home, and mine fast.

pages.title: Tiger's Eye Gear
pages.text: Tiger's Eye tools and armor stand shoulder to shoulder with the Ultimate line, and glitter considerably harder.$(p)Every ingot crosses two worlds to reach your anvil, so a full set is a statement: you went, you survived, and you came back rich.
